subject: Identification division structure
notes: kb/Work PB829. RENDERED from the printed page (PDF p293 / printed folio 263): `[ IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. ]`, then exactly one of program-id / function-id / class-id / factory / object / method-id / interface-id-paragraph, then `[ options-paragraph ]`. All seven source-unit paragraphs and OPTIONS are modelled and the residue is DIAGNOSED (COBOL1971, the pb829 negative). The BRACKETED header is now optional for the program and function units too (`identificationDivision : (IDENTIFICATION DIVISION DOT)? identificationBody`, wave 47 O) - it already was for the OO units - so `PROGRAM-ID. X.` as a unit's first line, and a header-less NESTED program, compile at 2002+ (the 2002 golden); X3.23-1985 required the header, so below 2002 it is the named relaxation gate identification-header-optional-2002 (COBOL0900, the 85 negative). Sibling fixed: the COBOL-WORDS placement stage (§7.3.10.3 SR1) now shares the ONE unit-start test with LEAP-SECOND (CompilationUnitStart.IsAt), so a directive after a header-less PROGRAM-ID is refused (COBOL1623).
